_comment: What POST /providers and PATCH /providers/{id} answer for a provider's name (SDD §4.2): every text that names the provider reads it, so a name that is missing, not a string or blank - no character outside Unicode's separators (Z), controls (Cc) and format characters (Cf) - is refused (422, in pydantic's words where the model refuses it) and nothing is stored; label_cases give the label a stored name reads as, for a provider whose id is dst-case. Shared by seamless/tests/test_api_resources.py, seamless/tests/test_models.py, dashboard/src/api/mock.test.ts and dashboard/src/lib/providerUse.test.ts (reviews RV20-11, RV21-07, RV21-08). Each case: the route, the name part of an otherwise valid body ({} = no name) -> the status and, for a refusal, the message.
